title: Implement Spacecraft Entity and Weapon System
description: Develop the player spacecraft class handling movement constraints within canvas bounds, rotation, and projectile firing logic with cooldown management. Include unit tests for movement physics and firing logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Spacecraft position updates based on input velocity vectors while respecting screen boundaries
Projectile generation respects the weapon cooldown timer
reviewFeedback: The implementation fully satisfies all requirements for the spacecraft entity, weapon system, boundary constraints, and projectile handling. Code adheres to clean modular practices, immutability, and includes appropriate unit tests.
